responsibility: Implements LONGREAL mathematical functions largely as wrappers around long-precision libm or compiler builtins. It maps the ISO LongMath API onto sqrtl/expl/logl/sinl/cosl and related functions, provides simple power and rounding behavior, and exposes a stub exception-status query for the long-real math runtime interface.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for LongMath: it maps the declared LONGREAL math API onto libm and cbuiltin long-precision routines such as sqrtl, expl, and sinl, whereas LongMath.def only declares that API.
